page.title: AfriNuts Batch Traceability | Farm OS Verified

promo.heading: Verify Your Shipment. Powered by Farm OS.
promo.lead: Enter your batch ID to confirm origin, quality grade, certifications, and current shipment status — all pulled directly from Farm OS. Full lab results, farmer profiles, GPS coordinates, and export documents are available to buyers in the Buyer Portal.
promo.subheading: Every AfriNuts shipment carries a unique traceability code. Anyone with the code can verify that the shipment exists, where it came from, and its current status. Buyers with portal access see the complete record — including lab results, farmer details, exact weights, and export documents.

batchIdExplainer.warningTitle: ORG does not mean certified organic
batchIdExplainer.warningBody: ORG describes how the batch was grown — organic agroforestry, no synthetic chemicals, currently in conversion toward organic certification. privacy.title: Public Summary. Private Details.
privacy.body: Every batch has a unique tracking code — printed on the QR sticker, Bill of Lading, and Certificate of Origin. Anyone with the code can verify the public record: origin, quality grade, certifications, and status. The full record — including lab results, buyer identity, farmer details, exact weights, and export documents — is only available to the verified buyer via the Buyer Portal.

faq.title: Common Questions
faq.q1: How do I find my batch ID?
faq.a1: Your batch ID is printed on the QR code sticker attached to every 50kg bag and on your Bill of Lading and Certificate of Origin.
faq.q2: What if the batch ID doesn't work?
faq.a2: Check for typos — batch IDs are case-sensitive. If it still doesn't work, contact us at contact@afrinutsexport.com with your invoice number.
faq.q3: Can I verify the digital signature independently?
faq.a3: Yes — every batch has a tamper-proof verification code you can check without login. The signature proves the data hasn't been altered since signing.
faq.q4: Who can see my batch record?
faq.a4: Anyone with your unique tracking code can view the public traceability summary (origin, quality grade, certifications, and status). However, the full private record — including lab results, farmer details, exact weights, export documents, and pricing — is only available to the verified buyer via the Buyer Portal login. We never allow browsing without a specific code.
faq.q5: How do I access my full buyer record?
faq.a5: Buyers receive a secure magic link by email whenever a batch is assigned to them. Click the link to sign in — no password required. If you're a buyer and haven't received your link, contact us at contact@afrinutsexport.com.
faq.q6: What do the letters in my batch ID mean?
faq.a6: A batch ID looks like this: AFN-FARM-ORG-260710-34D1 — AfriNuts, source, production method, date code, unique code. ORG means the batch was grown using organic practices: organic agroforestry, no synthetic chemicals, currently in conversion toward organic certification. ORG does NOT mean certified organic. A batch is only described as certified organic once a certificate has actually been issued, and that status will appear in the batch's certifications field. CONV means the batch was grown using conventional farming practices. Production method tells you how the crop was grown. Certification is a separate, audited status shown in the certifications field.

trust.title: What Makes Our Traceability Different

trust.batch: Unique batch IDs tracked in Farm OS from harvest to delivery — not a paper ledger
trust.public: Publicly verifiable summary — anyone with the batch ID can confirm origin, grade, and status
trust.certs: Certifications verified and displayed per batch — not just claims on a website
trust.ctaBody: Every wholesale order includes full Farm OS traceability. Buyers receive portal access to the complete record — lab results, farmer profiles, documents, and signatures — at no extra cost.

verify.title: Record Verification
verify.explanation: This verification code confirms that a Farm OS record was digitally signed and has not been altered. The signature is cryptographically tied to the original batch data.
